evidence: Original issue evidence: profiling/export.rs:52-78 only wrote Perfetto when enabled; zircon_runtime_interface/src/profiling/session_path.rs:9-55 computed a stable basename; profiling/mod.rs:129-140 allowed repeated export. Current resolution: profiling/export.rs:109-121 removes stale Perfetto when include_perfetto is false; export_snapshot_removes_perfetto_from_a_reused_session_directory:719-746 and export_snapshot_reports_failure_to_remove_stale_perfetto:747-772 verify removal and typed failure.
impact: Same-session export could previously expose a previous capture optional trace after Perfetto was disabled.
impact_or_question: 同一 session 第二次导出且关闭 Perfetto 时，目录中保留上次的 Perfetto 文件；需明确输出目录是否承诺只含本次报告。
